response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, staff-level generalist engineer with strong full-stack, DevOps, and leadership credentials, but his resume shows minimal direct evidence of the core GenAI requirements for this role. Only his current ~1-year role briefly mentions MCP and agentic workflow tooling, with no demonstrated experience in RAG, vector databases, multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI, cloud-native AI system design, or Python-based AI pipelines.
strengths: 15+ years of proven engineering experience with staff/senior titles across many companies
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic workflow infrastructure at re:cinq
Strong mentoring, teaching, and community leadership track record (workshops, talks, code katas)
concerns: No mention of Python, RAG architectures, vector databases, or LLM evaluation/observability experience
No evidence of leading customer-facing technical discovery sessions or enterprise consulting engagements
AI/GenAI experience appears limited to a few months in current role with no depth or specifics provided

key_factors.factor: Lack of RAG/vector DB/multi-agent GenAI experience
No Python skills listed despite being a required language
Strong general staff-level engineering and mentoring background
